## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the left arm to pick up the cylindrical can with bright colors, put it into the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, the other arm lifts the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.

Task description: The targets are the red-and-green cylindrical can on the left of the table and the central yellow rectangular basket with two black handles. The left arm puts the can inside, and the right arm lifts the basket containing it.

Success criteria: The can is inside the basket. The right arm lifts the basket and can a short distance so both are clearly above their respective initial heights. The can stays near and physically touches the basket and no longer touches the table; the opening remains generally upward without substantial sideways tilt.

## Execution tips

- When grasping the can, choose its straight cylindrical wall around the upper-middle section so the fingers contact opposite sides effectively, avoiding the rolled top rim and narrowed sections. Open slightly wider than the can diameter, balancing grasp stability with fingertip clearance inside the basket.
- The right arm may grip the middle of the black handle's horizontal section, avoiding pivots and bends. Match the opening to its thickness and clearance, confirming the fingers surround it before closing. If both handles naturally come together, grasping both may reduce basket tilt.
- A folded black handle lies inside the basket opening. Approach through an unobstructed area, leaving vertical and lateral clearance for the can bottom and gripper over the rim, while avoiding the right-arm grasp area to reduce snagging.
- Before releasing the can, let its bottom rest securely on the basket bottom to avoid hitting the rim or tipping while unsupported. Withdraw the left gripper clear of the handle and rim.
- Test-lift the basket slightly to observe loading and can movement, keeping its opening upward. If it tilts noticeably, restore table support before adjusting the handle grasp to avoid tipping it during a midair regrasp.
